_source: SkinWalker app/config.py (ENGINE_DEFAULTS, PRESETS) and app/effects.py (FX_PRESETS), copied 2026-10-09 for VOICE_CHANGER_PLAN.md brief S0
_notes: engine_defaults: the seed-vc parameters every conversion starts from (cli.py reads them); a preset's engine block overrides them.
voice: the stem of the preset's reference clip, <voices_dir>/<voice>.wav.
fx: the creature-FX intent after the conversion, as plain values. cli.py does not apply FX; BuzzEdit turns them into live rack effects (S1/S2).

SkinWalker's own UI applied only formant/drive/reverb/sub_octave of these: its fx pitch_semitones never reached the audio (the engine's pitch_shift did), and its formant was a shelf tilt, not a real formant shift.

fx_units.pitch_semitones: semitones, pitch shift after the conversion
fx_units.formant: formant shift amount, negative = darker/bigger (SkinWalker: shelf tilt of formant*2 dB, +low shelf 300 Hz / -high shelf 3 kHz)
fx_units.reverb: 0..1, room size = reverb, wet level = reverb*0.5
fx_units.sub_octave: 0..1, gain of a copy pitched -12 semitones mixed in
